source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 6 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Fractions with denominators 10, 100, 1 000 are written without a denominator, using a comma: decimal fractions.
stages.headlineEnglish: Fractions with denominators 10, 100, 1 000 are written without a denominator, using a comma: decimal fractions.

stages.headline: The whole part goes left of the comma, the fractional part to the right.
stages.headlineEnglish: The whole part goes left of the comma, the fractional part to the right.

stages.headline: The number of digits after the comma equals the number of zeros in the denominator; 0.3 is 3 parts of 10.
stages.headlineEnglish: The number of digits after the comma equals the number of zeros in the denominator; 0.3 is 3 parts of 10.
